question: Should OpenClaw adopt and support the proposed Microsoft Teams multi-account configuration and compatibility contract?
rationale: Automation can assess the implementation and proof, but it cannot decide whether `channels.msteams.accounts`, `defaultAccount`, root-setting inheritance, and the hybrid legacy shape should become permanent supported product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor and reopen
options.body: Accept the account model in principle, reopen this PR, and complete owner review of its compatibility and upgrade guarantees.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a smaller or staged account surface before accepting the full inheritance, setup, Graph, and persistent-state behavior.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Keep the PR closed and retain the existing single-bot Microsoft Teams contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and reopen
recommendation.body: Accept the account model in principle, reopen this PR, and complete owner review of its compatibility and upgrade guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting product and compatibility decision, and the available repository guidance identifies this person as the clearest decision owner.
